withheld_reason.contributions: PERIOD-vs-CUMULATIVE grain (owner-gated). The module's stated cumulative contribution total is 22,427.00; page 2's own printed >$50 box is 13,697 and the four ledger rows sum to exactly 13,697.00 (12,697.00 in-kind + 200.00 + 600.00 + 200.00). 13,697 is the cover's CURRENT REPORT column, not the cumulative one (13,697 + 8,730.00 last report = 22,427.00), so this ledger is PERIOD-scoped under a cumulative cover. Cover-differencing corroborates to the cent: 22,427.00 - 8,730.00 = 13,697.00, and the pre-election sibling 4020 states 8,730.00 contributions, matching 4278's Last Report column. Rows transcribed and parked; no sum claimed.
withheld_reason.expenditures: PERIOD-vs-CUMULATIVE grain (owner-gated). The module's stated cumulative expenditure figure is -25,353.12 (the filer wrote the cumulative as a NEGATIVE; magnitude 25,353.12 = 17,642.44 current + 7,710.68 last report). Page 3's own printed total box is 17,642.44 — the CURRENT REPORT column — so this ledger is PERIOD-scoped under a cumulative cover. The 10 transcribed rows sum to 17,642.74, i.e. +0.30 against the filer's own printed box (see recon.detail; every amount escalated and legible). Cover-differencing is WEAK on this side: 25,353.12 - 4020's stated 7,560.88 = 17,792.24, because 4278's Last Report column RESTATES 4020 (7,710.68 vs 7,560.88, a 149.80 restatement) — an established finding for this filer, not repaired here. Rows transcribed and parked; no sum claimed. Reconciliation was done against the MAGNITUDE of the negative cumulative figure; no sign was flipped in any published row (all ledger rows are printed positive and are stored positive).

contributions.detail: Side WITHHELD on the grain question, so no sum is claimed. For the record: the ledger's MONETARY rows sum to 1,000.00 and the single IN-KIND row is 12,697.00; monetary + in-kind = 13,697.00, which equals page 2's printed >$50 box EXACTLY. NOTE A SOURCE PROPERTY THE BRIEFS DO NOT LIST: on this filing the in-kind donation is written on the contribution schedule itself and IS INCLUDED in the printed >$50 box, and that box is the figure the cover promotes (13,697 current + 8,730.00 last = 22,427.00 cumulative). So Summit's cover contribution figure is NOT monetary-only here — the opposite of the McKenna-2024 precedent. The offsetting fact is on p3: the same Woodland Publishing 12,697.00 appears as an EXPENDITURE (11,200 mailers), so the in-kind is booked on both sides. Because the form's pre-2022 split50 ledger itemizes only donors >$50, no residual against the >$50 box exists and the <=$50 box is a blank nil mark.

expenditures.detail: Side WITHHELD on the grain question, so no sum is claimed. For the record: the 10 rows sum to 17,642.74 against page 3's own printed total box of 17,642.44 — the filer's arithmetic is 0.30 SHORT of his own rows. This is a filer-arithmetic delta, not a read: every amount cell was escalated to a 1200-1400 dpi tight crop and every one is unambiguous (916.75 / 349.60 / 246.79 / 1,663.44 / 12,697.00 / 1,200.00 / 244.30 / 89.00 / 231.86 / 4.00), and the two cells whose single-digit re-reading could have closed the page (American Mailing cents '44' vs '14'; Utah Republican Party '244.30' vs '244.00') were both escalated first and both read clean — the correlated-error trap was screened and did not fire. The printed box 17,642.44 is also what the cover's own arithmetic uses (17,642.44 + 7,710.68 = 25,353.12), so the 0.30 is carried through the filer's cover consistently. Row-count gate: 13 physical bands 5-17 hold 10 entries (the first three entries are two-line, occupying two bands each), which matches the 10 rows transcribed.

_meta_itemized.notes: Handwritten split50 sheet; the county OCR layer is noise on both ledger pages (draft.py unusable) so both pages were read full-page at 200 dpi and every disputed cell escalated as a tight crop. Both template SPECIMEN rows were left in place by the filer and are DROPPED: p2 '8/25/10 Jon and Jane Doe, PO Box 128, Coalville, UT 84017, $435.00' (band 5) and p3 '8/25/10 Name of Business, Campaign signs and flyers, $512.00' (band 4) — the printed totals close only without them. Privacy applied at read time: street addresses and PO boxes were discarded and never written here; only city/state are kept, and the filer's own abbreviations are expanded in the row notes ('PC' = Park City, 'SLC' = Salt Lake City) — no city was ever inferred from a zip. Row 4's address cell prints only 'Rexburg, Idaho' (no street, no zip) — left thin by the filer, not redacted; nothing on this filing is county-redacted. Geometry spot-verified end-to-end on two rows: p2 band 8 resolves to 'Summit Cnty Rep. / 9071 ... PC, UT / 84098 / 600.00' and p3 band 12 to 'Woodland Publishing / 11,200 mailers / 12,697.00' — both reproduce donor/vendor and amount. Two-line expenditure entries are stored on the band that carries the AMOUNT (bands 6, 8, 10); the entry's first line sits in the band above and is folded into vendor_raw/purpose, which is why those crops show the continuation line.
